mapper.select: SELECT tb.id AS block_id, tb.user_id AS block_user_id, tb.table_id AS block_table_id, tb.title AS block_title, tb.status, tb.width, tb.start_at, tb.color, tbt.id AS task_id, tbt.time_block_id AS task_block_id, tbt.title AS task_title, s.id AS schedule_id, s.user_id AS schedule_user_id, s.kind, s.start_at, s.end_at, s.start_date, s.end_date, s.title AS schedule_title FROM time_blocks tb LEFT JOIN time_block_tasks tbt ON tb.id = tbt.time_block_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON tb.schedule_id = s.id WHERE tb.id = #{id}

SELECT block.id AS block_id, block.user_id AS block_user_id, block.table_id AS block_table_id, block.title AS block_title, block.status, block.width, block.start_at, block.color, task.id AS task_id, task.time_block_id AS task_block_id, task.title AS task_title, schedule.id AS schedule_id, schedule.user_id AS schedule_user_id, schedule.kind, schedule.start_at, schedule.end_at, schedule.start_date, schedule.end_date, schedule.title AS schedule_title FROM time_blocks block LEFT JOIN time_block_tasks task ON block.id = task.time_block_id LEFT JOIN schedule schedule ON block.schedule_id = schedule.id WHERE (block_user_id = #{userId}) AND (block.status = 'HOLD')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO time_blocks (user_id, table_id, title, status, schedule_id, width, start_at, color) VALUES (#{userId}, #{timeTableId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{relatedSchedule.id}, #{width}, #{startAt}, #{color})
mapper.update: UPDATE time_blocks SET table_id = #{timeTableId}, title = #{title}, status = #{status}, schedule_id = #{relatedSchedule.id}, width = #{width}, start_at = #{startAt}, color = #{color} WHERE id = #{id}
